subject: Follow-up: Next steps & 30-min demo windows for HorizonHealth
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tran <etran@horizonhealth.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Nov 2028 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Next steps & 30-min demo windows for HorizonHealth

Hi Emily / Carlos —

Thanks again for the conversation today — really helpful to understand HorizonHealth's priorities around inference latency for clinical search and the gating items on procurement/security. Quick recap from our side: 

- Primary goals: faster, predictable inference for clinical search re-rank and a single API surface across hosted and private deployments.
- Key constraints: SOC2 evidence, VPC deployment for PHI workflows, and budget guardrails for production rollout.
- Success criteria you mentioned: <20% token-cost reduction vs current infra, p95 latency < 250ms for 512-token sequences in peak windows, and easy rollback controls.

Next step: we'd like to schedule a 30-minute product intro and ops/tech alignment where we can show the runtime in a short demo and map a potential pilot. Below are three 30-minute windows — all times PT (please tell us if you prefer ET and we'll convert):

1) Tue Nov 28, 10:00–10:30 PT (convert: 1:00–1:30 ET)
2) Wed Nov 29, 14:00–14:30 PT (convert: 5:00–5:30 ET)
3) Thu Nov 30, 08:00–08:30 PT (convert: 11:00–11:30 ET)

Can you pick the one that works best or propose an alternate slot? If possible, please include the technical owner who would own pilot ops and your security/compliance contact — that'll help us bring the right people.

I've attached a short discovery recap and the proposed agenda. Agenda (30m): 5m recap, 15m demo (runtime + routing/batching demo), 8m pilot next steps & Qs, 2m action items.

Attachments: [attachment: discovery-recap-horizonhealth.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

If any of these slots are tight, we can also offer a later-week evening ET slot — just say the word.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

— Logan
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
